title: Universal localization of simplicial maps
statement: Use small simplicial sets, degreewise pullbacks, quasicategories, functor simplicial sets, full subcategories and functor equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], enlarging universes as needed. A simplicial map $f:A\to B$ exhibits $B$ as a localization of $A$ at a collection $W\subseteq A_1$ if, for every quasicategory $\mathcal E$, precomposition $f^*:\operatorname{Fun}(B,\mathcal E)\to\operatorname{Fun}(A,\mathcal E)$ factors through the full subcategory of diagrams sending every edge of $W$ to an equivalence and induces a functor equivalence onto that subcategory. The map $f$ is universally localizing if for every small simplicial map $g:T\to B$ there exists a collection $W_g\subseteq(T\times_B A)_1$ such that the projection $T\times_B A\to T$ exhibits $T$ as a localization at $W_g$. The collection may depend on $g$ but must work for every $\mathcal E$. No quasicategory hypothesis is imposed on $A,B,T$.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q23-a4e56f284 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the definition in full and checked it against Kerodon online. Def 6.3.5.1 (02M0) says that for every map of simplicial sets S'->S, the projection S'x_S X->S' is a localization at some collection of edges W. Prop 6.3.1.13(2) (01MS) characterises localization as: for every infinity-category E, precomposition factors through Fun(C[W^-1],E) and is an equivalence. The node matches clause by clause. f, A, B and T are arbitrary, with no quasicategory hypothesis. The base change is the degreewise pullback along every small g. W_g may depend on g and does not depend on E. The full functor equivalence is kept, not weakened to the core or to pi_0. The only stmt_dep, def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones, defines every notion used: quasicategories, equivalence edges, Fun(K,C), full subcategories, functor equivalence and degreewise pullbacks. Proof and proof_deps are empty, as they should be for a definition. Edge cases agree with Kerodon and with the three citers (contractible-factor 02M8, pushout 02MA, and finite-embedded-simplex-resolution steps 3 and 7, which use stability under base change and g=1_X): g=id, T=empty (Fun(empty,E)=Delta^0), and f=id with W=empty. Grepping the DAG and blueprint found no duplicate definition, so same_as [] holds. The four recorded Mathlib searches found no match. This is not a target node, so the base-change morphism and coefficient-category checks do not apply. There are no new nodes, no tool_uses and no changes. The online Kerodon source with the archive marked WANTED is accepted, following the neighbouring nodes. Details are in review.md.
